title: Open, register or close a trust account (property)
summary: Learn how to open, register, or close a trust account required for licensees under the Property and Stock Agents Act 2002.
intro: If you're a Licensee under the Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 – such as a real estate agent, strata managing agent or stock and station agent – you must hold clients’ funds in a trust account kept at an authorised deposit-taking institution in NSW.
who_can_apply: Licensee under the Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 (e.g., real estate agent, strata managing agent, or stock and station agent)
what_you_need: Details for the name of the trustee accounts

how_to_steps.text: Select the relevant link to notify Fair Trading online of your intention in relation to a property trust account.
Create a new registration number for a new trust account that has not yet been opened.
Create a registration number for an existing trust account that has already been opened.
You must notify Fair Trading within 14 days after closing a trust account.
Note: if you are not able to close a trust account online, you can download and complete Notice of closing of a trust account – PDF.
You can access a closed trust account online by entering your account details.

more_info.text: When you write a cheque to draw funds from the trust account, you must include the words ‘trust account’.

external_links.text: Notice of closing of a trust account – PDF

internal_links.text: Lodge real estate or conveyancer trust account audits

faqs.q: Who must hold clients' funds in a trust account?
faqs.a: Licensees under the Property and Stock Agents Act 2002, such as real estate agents, strata managing agents, or stock and station agents, must hold clients’ funds in a trust account kept at an authorised deposit-taking institution in NSW.

faqs.q: What are the requirements for managing trust accounts?
faqs.a: The licensee or firm (a corporation) must register separate accounts with NSW Fair Trading. A unique identifying number will be issued for each account, which must then be provided to the authorised deposit-taking institution for monthly returns.

faqs.q: How do I close a trust account?
faqs.a: You must notify Fair Trading within 14 days after closing the trust account. You can close it online using the provided link, or download and complete the Notice of closing of a trust account – PDF.
